prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, visually striking scene set in a monochromatic yellow room with vertically ridged wall panels. The focal point is a large, vertically oriented digital display embedded in the wall, showcasing three iPhones in silver, gold, and space gray, with the word "iPhone" in crisp white text above them. To the right of the display stands a young woman with straight, shoulder-length red hair, dressed in a coordinated yellow outfit that blends seamlessly with the environment. She gestures enthusiastically toward the screen with both arms, as if presenting or unveiling the product. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that enhance the depth of the ridged wall texture. The overall style is sleek and contemporary, with a playful, almost surreal monochrome palette dominated by warm yellow tones. The composition is balanced, with the presenter and the digital display forming a dynamic diagonal line, and the camera angle is straight-on at eye level, emphasizing clarity and focus on the product and presenter. The mood is energetic, inviting, and futuristic, reminiscent of a high-end tech commercial or a stylized product launch event.
